title: The Bat at the Park
text: On Saturday, Marco packed his glove and his favorite wooden bat and headed to the park for baseball practice. He set his bat down by the bench and jogged over to warm up with his team. While he stretched, his little sister tugged his sleeve and pointed toward the old oak tree at the edge of the field. A small brown bat swooped out of a hole in the trunk, dipping and looping through the evening air before vanishing over the fence. Marco's sister looked puzzled and asked how the creature flying over the fence could share a name with the wooden stick leaning against the bench. Marco laughed and admitted English could be strange that way. When practice ended, he grabbed his bat off the bench, swung it once over his shoulder, and walked home with his sister, who kept glancing up at the sky in case the other bat came back.
